key_points: Nike shares down ~44% YTD, at 13-year lows ahead of Q1 earnings
Record short interest of 87M shares ($1.4B paper gains) creates squeeze potential
Consensus expects EPS $0.44 (down from $0.49) and revenue decline 3.4% to $11.3B
Company resetting China strategy and digital approach; Morgan Stanley cites elevated valuation risk
Former officer insider selling 12,658 Class B shares; retail sentiment mixed but largely bearish
